semantics.rust_signature: fn abs_with_context_exact_native(backend: &CpuBackend, input: &Tensor, context: &ExecutionContext<'_>) -> Result<Tensor, ElementwiseRuntimeError>
semantics.mutation_rule: out of place; input storage and descriptor are unchanged
semantics.shape_rule: output shape exactly equals input shape, including scalar and empty tensors
semantics.dtype_rule: the certified CPU overload accepts and returns f32
semantics.layout_rule: logical values are projected to canonical contiguous output
semantics.device_rule: CPU ordinal zero is certified; other devices fail typed
semantics.numeric_rule: IEEE absolute value preserves NaN and clears the sign bit of negative zero
semantics.tolerance: bit exact except the preserved NaN payload is not compared
semantics.cancellation_points: before dispatch, inside the canonical backend loop, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: gradient is output_gradient times sign(input), with zero derivative at either signed zero
semantics.jvp_rule: tangent is input_tangent times sign(input), with zero derivative at either signed zero
